title: Create PRD acceptance concierge workflow for fast cross-team micro-decisions
creator: Priya Patel
description: Problem: PRD reviews for features that touch privacy, regional routing, or model pinning often stall on small clarifications (micro-decisions) that block shipping. Current signoff threads produce long email/Slack chains and duplicated doc artifacts. Goal: create a lightweight 'acceptance concierge' workflow that centralizes micro-decision capture, provides clear SLAs for responses by Eng/Design/Legal, and automates checklist advancement for PRD acceptance so product teams can ship on time without skipping compliance checks.
acceptance_criteria: Concierge checklist template (one-page) published in Confluence and linked from PRD
Response SLA defined: 48h for design/engineering clarifications, 72h for legal privacy/contract review; exceptions logged and escalated
Rotation schedule for on-duty reviewers (ENG/Design/Legal) created and integrated with calendar/Slack reminders
Automated gating: PRD cannot be marked 'Ready for Implementation' unless checklist has final resolution entries or approved fallback
Two pilot PRDs complete the workflow with no >5 business day blocking comments and documented lessons learned
decisions: Use a single canonical ticket attached to each PRD as the acceptance concierge (PM- prefix) rather than multiple siloed threads
Capture micro-decisions in structured rows: question, owner, decision, rationale, link-to-artifact
Fallback policy: after SLA expiry, on-duty reviewer must either approve, provide a mitigation, or escalate to the PM on-call
Legal privacy triage: classify items into informational, contract-impacting, and gating. Only gating items require legal signoff before implementation
